chunks: A section were guided, and a section were bound to go astray, for they took the devils as allies instead of God, yet they think they are on the right path.
ai.seo_question: Why did some people go astray according to Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological mechanism of *ghurur* (self-deception), where the misguided believe their adherence to devils (*awliya'*) constitutes true guidance. It underscores the concept of divine decree (*hukm*) intertwined with human agency, as their choice to elevate devils over God sealed their fate of misguidance.
